svg.title: Evidence archive
svg.desc: An isometric archive of registered evidence sources. A wave passes through the cards, one card is drawn out and its record opens: what the source supports and what it does not. Four sources cycle: FoodData Central 2025-04-24, FAO Food and Nutrition Paper 77, Nutt et al. 1989 and Duan et al. 2021.
